description: This source file defines a Swift module for discovering Tailscale gateway nodes on macOS. It includes structures for representing discovered beacons, a discovery context, functions for collecting candidates, probing hosts, and parsing Tailscale status. The core logic involves asynchronously querying the Tailscale status, resolving executable paths, and probing candidate nodes via WebSocket connections to identify active gateways.

methods.name: discover
methods.description: Asynchronously discovers Tailscale gateway beacons within a specified timeout, returning a sorted list based on display names.

methods.name: collectCandidates
methods.description: Collects candidate nodes from the current Tailscale status, filtering out self and offline nodes.

methods.name: readTailscaleStatus
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the Tailscale status JSON by executing the Tailscale binary.

methods.name: probeHostForGatewayChallenge
methods.description: Probes a host via WebSocket to detect a gateway challenge event.
